_meta.purpose: OBS Studio scene collection for Track 2 (social-seeding-v2) recording.
_meta.authority: implements gcp-research/demo/SCRIPT.md §2.1 (three-scene layout) and §3 (6-beat storyboard: brief intake -> vetting fan-out -> outreach tournament + approval -> Gmail send + reply -> logistics + verify -> analyst + cost ledger).
_meta.rationale: Three named scenes cover every beat. Scene A is the full Mission Control workspace used for the wide reasoning shots. Scene B narrows to the relevant pane when the workflow zooms (e.g. the cost ledger card during Beat 3). Scene C splits browser + terminal side-by-side for the Beat 1 trigger and the Beat 6 cost ledger drilldown.
_meta.import_target: OBS Studio Scene Collection (Scene Collection > Import)

name: social-seeding-v2-track2

sources.name: Audio Output - Desktop
sources._note: captured for system-beep and Gmail-arrival ping moments during Beat 4; otherwise muted in mixer

scenes.name: Mission Control - full
scenes._purpose: Default scene used for Beats 2, 3, 5, 6 of Track 2. Full Mission Control workspace at 1080p, no overlay.

scenes.name: Mission Control - zoom
scenes._purpose: Used when the demo narrows to a single Mission Control pane (e.g. the cost ledger card in Beat 6). Captures the foreground Chrome Mission Control window directly so the address bar + tabs do not leak in.

scenes.name: Terminal + browser split
scenes._purpose: Used in Beat 1 (operator runs scripts/run-demo.ts in terminal; Mission Control reacts on the right) and Beat 4 (terminal showing Inngest dashboard CLI on the left; Gmail Sent folder on the right). Source order matters: terminal goes first because it is the trigger.

_beat_to_scene_map._doc: Operator follows this map during recording. SCRIPT.md §3 beats map to OBS scene hotkeys 1/2/3 (Cmd+1, Cmd+2, Cmd+3).

_install_note: OBS Studio > Scene Collection > Import > select this file. After import, edit each window-capture source to point at the actual Chrome window (Mission Control) and iTerm2 session — these are host-specific window IDs that cannot be hard-coded across operators.
_pre_record_validation: Cmd+1 switches to Mission Control - full (verify with the live preview)
Cmd+2 switches to Mission Control - zoom (verify Chrome window is selected)
Cmd+3 switches to Terminal + browser split (verify both sources visible at 50/50)
Audio mixer shows mic at -12 dBFS during a 30 s test narration
Desktop audio peaks below -20 dBFS unless a Gmail arrival ping plays (intentional)
Cursor highlight overlay is visible in every scene (separate Lua plugin, see cursor-highlight.lua)
